youtube.title: Which country has no rivers at all? It drinks the sea instead 💧
youtube.description:
The island continent, the desert kingdom, or the land of the great river? One of them has not a single river that flows all year and no natural lake, yet millions live in its capital. The water arrives by pipeline, hundreds of kilometres from the coast, after being pulled out of the sea.
Which did you pick?
